name: Opponents' surface Elo, last 52 weeks
description: Mean pre-match surface Elo (log-odds scale) of the opponents a player met over the last year, shrunk toward the tour's typical opponent with phantom opponents; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom opponents) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 20, women 20

name: Opponents' surface Elo, decayed (52-week half-life)
description: The same mean of opponents' surface Elo with every earlier match weighted by a one-year half-life; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom opponents) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 0, women 20

name: Opponents' serve + return ratings, last 52 weeks
description: Mean pre-match serve-plus-return rating (the earlier study's ratings) of the last year's opponents, shrunk with phantom opponents; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom opponents) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 20, women 20

name: Quality of wins: surface Elo of opponents beaten, last 52 weeks
description: Quality of wins: mean surface Elo of the opponents a player beat over the last year, shrunk; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom opponents) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 20, women 5

name: Surface Elo of opponents lost to, last 52 weeks
description: Mean surface Elo of the opponents a player lost to over the last year, shrunk; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom opponents) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 5, women 20

name: Results above Elo's expectation, last 52 weeks
description: Results above surface Elo's expectation over the last year: won minus Elo's pre-match probability, summed over matches plus phantom matches; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom opponents) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 20, women 0

name: Results above Elo's expectation against strong opponents, last 52 weeks
description: Results above surface Elo's expectation against opponents above the tour's main-tour median Elo, over the last year, shrunk; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom opponents) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 2, women 5

name: Old opponents' Elo now minus then, all opponents, last 52 weeks
description: Retrospective credit: for the last year's opponents, their latest pre-match surface Elo from an earlier week minus their Elo at the meeting, later rematches taken out, averaged and shrunk; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom encounters) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 5, women 20

name: Old opponents' Elo now minus then, opponents beaten, last 52 weeks
description: The retrospective credit over the opponents a player beat; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom encounters) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 0, women 5

name: Old opponents' Elo now minus then, opponents lost to, last 52 weeks
description: The retrospective credit over the opponents a player lost to; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom encounters) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 20, women 20

name: Old opponents revalued by their later matches only, all opponents, last 52 weeks
description: The retrospective credit from the opponents' later matches only: the meeting's own Elo update and later rematches taken out (the UFC rule); A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom encounters) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 2, women 20

name: Old opponents revalued by their later matches only, opponents beaten, last 52 weeks
description: The later-matches-only credit over the opponents a player beat; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom encounters) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 2, women 5

name: Old opponents revalued by their later matches only, opponents lost to, last 52 weeks
description: The later-matches-only credit over the opponents a player lost to; A minus B.
tuned: K (phantom encounters) from {0, 2, 5, 10, 20}, per tour, by the in-sample log-loss gain given Elo on 2013-2018: men 20, women 20

name: Late-match decline (Grand Slam point by point), career
description: A player's change in serve-point win rate from the first two sets to the third set onward, relative to the opponent's, over earlier Grand Slam point-by-point matches, shrunk; A minus B.
tuned: late-decline shrinkage K (effective points): men 944 (season), women 808 (career)

name: Late-match decline x best of five
description: The late-decline difference multiplied by whether the match is best of five (the source's record); men only.
tuned: late-decline shrinkage K (effective points): men 944 (season), women 808 (career)

name: Late-match decline x expected match length (closeness)
description: The late-decline difference multiplied by the match's expected closeness from the earlier study's ratings through the iid model.
tuned: late-decline shrinkage K (effective points): men 944 (season), women 808 (career)

name: Grinder: points won above expectation in long minus short matches, career
description: A player's total points won above the earlier study's ratings' expectation in long matches (minutes per set above the tour's upper quartile) minus in short ones, career, shrunk; A minus B.
tuned: grinder shrinkage K (effective points): men 14690 (career), women 10098 (career); long-match line 46 (men) and 46.5 (women) minutes per set, the 2010-2018 upper quartile

name: Grinder: points won above expectation in long minus short matches, last 52 weeks
description: The grinder contrast over the last year, shrunk; A minus B.
tuned: grinder shrinkage K (effective points): men 14690 (career), women 10098 (career); long-match line 46 (men) and 46.5 (women) minutes per set, the 2010-2018 upper quartile

name: Grinder (career) x best of five
description: The career grinder difference multiplied by whether the match is best of five; men only.
tuned: grinder shrinkage K (effective points): men 14690 (career), women 10098 (career); long-match line 46 (men) and 46.5 (women) minutes per set, the 2010-2018 upper quartile

name: Sets over the last 14 days x late-match decline
description: Each player's sets over the last two weeks (log of one plus) times their late-decline trait; A's product minus B's.
tuned: late-decline shrinkage K (effective points): men 944 (season), women 808 (career)

name: Minutes over the last 14 days x late-match decline
description: Each player's minutes over the last two weeks (log of one plus) times their late-decline trait; A's product minus B's.
tuned: late-decline shrinkage K (effective points): men 944 (season), women 808 (career)

name: Elo's change over 12 months
description: The earlier study's rundown row: overall Elo now minus at the first match on or after a year before; A minus B.

name: Level played over the last 52 weeks
description: The earlier study's rundown row: share of the last year's matches played in main-tour main draws; A minus B.

name: Matches played (last 52 weeks)
description: The earlier study's rundown row: log of one plus the matches played over the last year; A minus B.

name: Sets over the last 14 days
description: The earlier study's rundown row: log of one plus the sets played over the last two weeks; A minus B.

name: Surface Elo (Stage 1) as a feature
description: Surface Elo's own log-odds that A wins, scored only as an input added to the earlier study's serve and return ratings: the reference for what results-based strength adds to them.
